notes: Context: Atlas Queryworks provides enterprise legal discovery + wealth-management research. Heavy emphasis on precise retrieval for compliance/legal audits.
Current infra: on-prem Faiss cluster for ANN + a lightweight BM25 fallback. Index size ~120M docs, steady-state QPS ~80-150 (spikes to 300 during close cycles).
Primary objective: migrate embeddings + reranker to Redwood to reduce operational overhead and unify private/dedicated serving while keeping or improving relevance and lowering per-query cost.

Quality guardrails: SOC2 + data residency constraints mean model/model-variant hosting must be in-customer VPC or air-gapped subnet. Legal team: "no silent regressions on key queries" — want eval-driven rollout.

Performance targets: end-to-end P99 < 600ms, median < 250ms for standard queries; reranker tail allowed up to 900ms for long context but want p50 < 350ms. Cost target: incremental cost per query < $0.003 at 150 QPS baseline.
Indexing concerns: re-index cadence weekly; need fast incremental updates. Current Faiss rebuilds take ~6 hours for full index; they want incremental merge support + warm caches to reduce lag.

Models being considered: Redwood-embed-v2-quant (8-bit) for primary embeddings; fallback to open-embed-2 for edge cases. Reranker candidates: cross-encoder finetune on in-house labels (1.2M triplets) and a lightweight distilled LTR model for latency-sensitive endpoints.

Evals plan: build reproducible eval harness in Drive (link above). Metrics: MRR@10, P@1, NDCG@10, %query-regressions > baseline, and latency buckets. Define pass/fail thresholds and early-stop rules for canaries.
Canary strategy: staged rollout: 0->10% (2 weeks) -> 50% (1 week) -> 100% if no regression. A/B to run paired-judgment evals on 5k seed queries and live user signal (clicks/conversions).
Observed risk: initial Redwood-embed-v2 quantization introduced a drop in P@1 on legal-fact queries in internal preview (delta -3.4%). Client worried about false negatives in e-discovery chains.

Mitigation: run simultaneous cross-encoder reranker on top of new embeddings for canary; maintain BM25 backup route. Use Redwood Optimize to suggest batching/quant profiles and to run automatic quality monitoring and regression alerts tied to eval sets.
Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "We will trade some cost for reliability, but cannot accept legal misses — if metrics slip on our top-200 legal queries, freeze rollout and rollback automatically."

Commercial: looking at a Dedicated + Private combo. Dedicated for predictable throughput during spikes; Private (VPC) to meet residency & KMS requirements. Procurement prefers annual commit with reserved GPU pools.

Open questions for AE/SE: need example SLA language for automatic rollback on metric regression; detailed quantization benchmark on their 120M corpus; run cost sim for 150 QPS at various batch/kv cache configs.
Suggested next meetings: 30m technical deep dive with infra + security (SE + infra sec), and 60m eval-sprint kickoff to lock metrics and set up eval harness (include product manager and legal).
